en:
This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy!

It is now 10 p.m.
It's beddy-bye time for us.

Oh, the three of us could all sleep in one
big bed, right?

Huh!? But whoever's in the top bunk might
fall outta bed and dieeeeee!
Ugh... I dunno if we're that close...

<CLT=cltMIND>We haven't done it for a while because of the
murder, but we're going to do it tonight, right?
<CLT=cltMIND>In that case, I need to go to the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I got back to my room, I huffed out
a deep sigh and fell backwards onto my bed.

Kaito bringing Maki...
he really is crazy.

But maybe it's because he's crazy
that Maki came in the first place.

<CLT=cltMIND>My eyelids closed as I continued talking to
myself, and eventually I drifted to sleep.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a normal bed.
It was pretty comfortable.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why did they go out of their way to make
this? What purpose could this serve?
